subject: Trade Brigade Newsletter 💰 06/30/25

self_score.opener:
The S&P 500 finally made a new all-time high last week, closing up 3.34% from Monday’s open and up 0.27% from the previous record set in February.

Reminder: This week is a shortened trading week with markets closing early Thursday and completely closed Friday for the Fourth of July holiday.

spy_levels.section: S&P weekly chart – Strong close on the highest high. The look above and fail, failed. Sellers had their shot, and couldn't make it happen.
spy_levels.sentence: If markets pull back, its still possible that the higher low on the weekly can be the China Gap Fill Reversal ~565 area.

spy_levels.section: S&P daily chart – Strong close to end the week with sustained support over the prior ATH. Higher highs, with possibly to set higher lows. Looking for 604.75 as the ideal higher low pullback, but the line in the sand for the daily trend will now be the Ceasefire Gap Fill Reversal ~600.5.

swing_ideas.text: Longstanding weekly base thats being tested. If price can clear 24.15, looking for a thin structure retracement back up towards the highs of 33.8. Not interested until the base breaks.
Bull flag over prior resistance. Looking for breaks of the trendline or the Friday/Thursday highs. Target pivot high up towards 42. Losing interest if the 37 level breaks.

Looking for a break to all time highs over the neckline of what could be considered an inverted head and shoulders. Clearance of 55 and 55.75 get this moving. Not interested if price starts to move below the 50 SMA (blue) which has held the right shoulder nicely.

More traditional inverted head and shoulders happening at the lows of the weekly move. Over 85.45 and targets step up around the daily 200 SMA (green) and the unfilled gap around 91. Like EQH chart, 50 SMA (blue) needs to hold the right shoulder.

Revisiting this setup in the triangle after the gap and go. Bullish 3 bar play in force after Friday's close. Over 12.15, looking for continuation towards the 15 area. Manage expectations, outside of a catalyst, this is a slow mover.
